notes: Reachable: embedded servlet container, every HTTP request an agent makes passes through it. Transitive path lab40-crm > spring-boot-starter-web:3.3.5 > spring-boot-starter-tomcat:3.3.5 > tomcat-embed-core:10.1.31. Version is managed by spring-boot-starter-parent, so remediation is a parent bump not a pinned override. Largest single cluster: 34 of 70 findings.

Reachable: spring-web is the MVC request path for /api/customers/**. Both arrive via the Boot BOM; spring-core also appears under spring-boot-starter-test but is compile scope in the runtime graph. Same parent-bump remediation as lab40-001.

Reachable: the framework the application runs on. Also reported against spring-boot-starter-web under the same CPE, so those 5 findings are the same 5 counted twice, not 10 distinct issues. Parent bump.

Highest priority despite not being the highest score: this is the authn/authz path that SecurityConfig and JwtAuthenticationFilter depend on, and a flaw here undermines the role checks the whole CRM relies on. Transitive via spring-boot-starter-security:3.3.5. Parent bump.

Reachable: deserializes every request body, including CreateCustomerRequest on POST/PUT /api/customers. Path lab40-crm > spring-boot-starter-web > spring-boot-starter-json > jackson-databind. Parent bump.

The one DIRECT dependency in this list, declared at runtime scope in pom.xml, though its version is still managed by the Boot BOM. Reachable: carries every query to crm40. Parent bump moves it, or pin explicitly if the BOM lags.

log4j-core is NOT on the classpath. dependency:tree shows only log4j-to-slf4j:2.23.1 > log4j-api:2.23.1; Boot routes logging to Logback via the slf4j bridge. The matched CPE cpe:2.3:a:apache:log4j covers the log4j product as a whole, and these CVEs require the core implementation that is absent here. Re-verify after any parent bump in case log4j-core is pulled in.

CPE mismatch. The JAR is org.eclipse.angus:angus-activation but the matched CPE is cpe:2.3:a:eclipse:angus_mail - a different product. angus-activation is the JAF activation implementation; angus-mail is the mail library. Arrives at runtime scope via spring-boot-starter-data-jpa > hibernate-core > jaxb-runtime > jaxb-core, and this application sends no mail.

Not a defect under current policy: the application has no ownership model - no owner column in V1/V2, no agent-to-customer link - so every agent is entitled to every customer and the role check in SecurityConfig:33 is the correct boundary. Recorded rather than dropped because if the policy is ever that agents are scoped to a book, this becomes the most serious finding in the assessment and needs a schema change, an authz check and a test.

FIXED and proven. Reproducer ForgedTokenSecurityTest written first: forged ADMIN token signed with the committed default returned HTTP 200 from AdminController#ping. Fix removed the fallback so application.yml reads ${JWT_SECRET}, value supplied via gitignored .env; app now fails startup when absent. Same test, unchanged, now returns 401. Regression: 22 tests before, 23 after, all green.
